title: High School Trips
text: We arrived on Cal Mira Island the next morning.
“Welcome. To the Four Holy Heroes and your entire party.”
I’ve seen him before. If I recall correctly, he’s the lord who manages Cal Mira Island. I remember him treating us with great courtesy when we came to soak in the hot springs.

The first time I came to Cal Mira Island, I really thought it felt just like a tourist spot. Come to think of it, I do recall having been to Hawaii… Before I was summoned to this world, back when I was in high school, I went there with a group of pigs as my guides. A rich pig used his own money to take us on an overseas trip.
By the way, this is a different pig from the landowner’s daughter I mentioned earlier. I seem to recall this one was even richer.

I feel like we used to visit tourist spots all over the world—including Japan—about once a month. Well, since we had school, it was either on weekends, during summer or winter break, or we’d use our money to get special exemptions just for us—looking back now, I feel like we were cheating the system. I suppose that just goes to show I was an untrustworthy man back then, unworthy of Filo-tan.
Anyway, I think the ocean is even more beautiful now than it was back then. By the way, I’ve also been to Guam.
As for this count, I think I’d been thinking I might have seen a description of him in the game. I’m pretty sure his name comes up in a quest. A ghost… was it? Maybe a relative or an ancestor.
“I am Earl of Habenburg, entrusted with the governance of the Cal Mira Islands.”
“Uh, uh-huh…”

Father will handle the introduction. Itsuki only vaguely remembers what happened the day before and still looks like he’s suffering from seasickness. How is that possible when he slept the whole time?
“It’s a pleasure to make your acquaintance.”
“Ah… the pleasure is mine.”
“Well then, my heroes, let me tell you about the origins of the Cal Mira Islands.”
I’ve heard this part before, so I’ll just let it wash over me. It’s the story of the islands’ traditional monsters. Since I’ve never actually seen one, they must be extinct by now.
“Huh… that looks kind of tasty.”
“Sakura-chan. I’d like you to be a little more refined.”
“Hm? Got it—Mel-chan.”
Just listening to the conversation between the Finacée and Sakura-chan reminds me of Filo-tan.
“I want to try eating one. Iwatani! If you find one, cook it for me!”
“I don’t think they’re the kind of opponent we should fight. It’s wrong to forcefully attack someone we can talk to. Kou.”
“Ugh…”
Kou is holding back out of fear of being butchered.
“You mustn’t eat cute monsters.”
Luna-chan says this while hugging Keel.
“Luna-chan, you’re hot!”
“It’s a tropical climate… I don’t like it when Keel-kun gets hot when I hug him.”

The Filolial-sama seemed interested, but since they aren’t here, there’s nothing to be done about it. Yuki-chan seems to be listening carefully to the island tour. I guess if anything comes up, I should just ask Yuki-chan?
“Boo.”
“Huh? When am I supposed to enjoy my vacation? Elena, you’re getting ahead of yourself.”
The Lazy Pig seems completely ready to play. Next up is the inscription left by the hero. This area hasn’t changed much since the first world.

This is the part where my father reads the inscription and learns “Aura,” and then, since Itsuki and Ren can’t learn it, they ask how to obtain a weapon that grants the impossible skill “Understanding Otherworldly Languages.” However… I didn’t hear the pig’s voice, even though he was supposed to have explained “Aura.”
“Motoyasu-kun”
“What is it?”
“What will Itsuki and Ren learn once they can read that inscription?”

“If I recall correctly, Ren gets ‘Magic Enchant,’ and Itsuki gets ‘Down.’ Ren’s ability absorbs enemy magic—similar to my ‘Absorb’—and turns it into a magic sword, while Itsuki’s is the opposite of my Father’s aura: a spell that lowers all of the enemy’s stats.”
“That’s what he said.”
“Don’t just make stuff up…”
Itsuki and Ren are brushing off my words with obvious annoyance. Is it really right to blame others for your own lack of preparation?
After that, we were briefed on the precautions for staying on Cal Mira Island. It felt like a lesson on online gaming etiquette, but this is the bare minimum you need to remember.

As for getting around, since Yuki-chan and the other Filolial-samas are with us, the sea has a gentle continental shelf with calm waves—it’s perfectly fine. Watching the Filolial-samas swim through the sea like waterfowl is a joy to behold. When swimming deep or fast, they lean their bodies forward like penguins. I remember Filo-tan swimming that way, and Ku and Marin did it too. Midori, on the other hand, swam in human form.

Well then, we’ve arranged to stay at the castle—the finest hotel on Cal Mira Island. Since my father and I have quite a large group, they’ve prepared plenty of rooms for us. For some reason, it looked like my finacée was going to end up in a room alone with my father. My father protested vehemently, so it seems she’ll be sharing a room with Sakura-chan after all. Suddenly, out of nowhere, a pig appeared and is whispering something to us.
“Oink.”
“Oh, right. I guess we’re supposed to swap teams before the meeting, right?”
“Oink.”
“Motoyasu and I have been sticking together quite a bit, so our teammates get along well too…”
My father turned his gaze toward the Panda Beastman.
“Lars-chan, we’re going to be swapping teams for a while, but since you don’t really know us that well, you don’t have to join us, right?”
“That’s true. Even if we were asked to explain who you are, we wouldn’t have much to say. All we can really say is that you were really stiff.”
“So, until the swap is over, feel free to do whatever you want on the island.”
“Yeah, yeah. Well, I guess I’ll just have some of this island’s famous liquor and have some fun.”
“Big Sis! How about leveling up on the island?”
“Well, even if you say that…”
“Oh, Lars-chan.”
“What is it?”
“Just because you’ve got time on your hands doesn’t mean you should go out and get a tan—don’t end up looking like a tan panda or something. It doesn’t look very good.”
“Why are you even worrying about my skin, anyway?!”
“Because I don’t think a tan suits you.”
Looks like my father is having a heated argument with a panda beastman.
“Bro, what about us?”
“I guess Keel, Wyndia, Sakura, and Gaelion count as my crew, right?”
“Oink…”
When the Lazy Pig grunted, my Father looked completely deflated. Did he say something inappropriate again?
“Elena… in a way, I have to admire your dedication to laziness.”
“What are you saying?”
“‘Leave it to me to look after Melty, who’s supposed to be idle during the member swap!’ That’s what she said.”
“I want to go too.”
My Finacée raised her hand.
“I think the team swap should focus on people who’ve fought alongside me and Motoyasu. We’ve been together for a while, Melty-chan, but you haven’t actually fought with us, have you?”
“Y-yeah.”
“You’ll be fighting alongside us from now on, but would it be okay if you stayed behind this time?”
“But… Sakura-chan won’t be here either, right?”
“Well, that’s how it’ll be. Sakura-chan is the one who guards me, after all. It might be lonely, but it’s just a little while.”
“…Yeah. I get it.”
“It’s a relief you’re so understanding.”
“In return…”
My finacée seems to be fidgeting a bit. Father seems to have noticed something and clears his throat lightly to change the subject.
“For now, until the team swap is over, Melty-chan, please just relax with Elena-san.”
“Understood, Shield Hero—no, Naofumi…-san.”
She’s giving me that girlish look again. I won’t let that happen! Filo-tan wouldn’t allow it. I step between my fiancée and my Father to block her.
“W-what is it?”
I give her a silent, withering glare. Then, as if she’d recognized me as an enemy, my fiancée glared right back at me.
“……What about Luna? Isn’t she with Keel-kun?”
“Well, since Luna-chan is technically registered as a Filolial under Motoyasu-kun, I guess you could say she’s part of his group.”
“I see… I guess so.”
“That’s right.”
Luna-chan stares intently at Keel.
“Luna, I want to be with Keel-kun.”
“Luna-chan……”
“I want to hug Keel-kun, cuddle him, dress him up, and admire him.”
“Alright! Big Bro! We’re going to show the other big brothers just how awesome you are!”
Ignoring Luna-chan, who seemed reluctant to leave as if flipping a switch, Keel said to Father. What did Luna-chan do wrong, I ask you!?
“Keel, you need to understand how Luna-chan feels, you know.”
“I’m a guy! I’m only dressing up because you asked me to—I’m not doing it for no reason!”
“Ahaha…”
Father gave a wry smile.
“Oink.”
The pig that appeared is saying something. At that, the Assistant’s expression clearly turned displeased, and he furrowed his brow.
“Ren is my partner for the member swap. So, Motoyasu-kun will be with Itsuki, then?”
Hmm, so I’m with Itsuki’s group? Though, come to think of it, that’s what I was doing in the first world, too. But since Smoked Meat isn’t here this time, things might be a little different.
Just then, the Assistant grabs Father’s cloak tightly. Are you trying to take Father away from me, too?
“I know you might not like it since he’s the one who killed your dad, but please bear with it just a little.”
“Yeah. Got it. I’ll do my best.”
“I hate this, but I’ll entertain him!　I’m going to show that wimpy Sword Hero just how strong Gaelion is!”
“I’m counting on you, Gaelion-chan.”
“Exactly! Gaelion will do the talking so my big sister can put up with it.”
And just like that, my rival is making her case to Father. Ugh… Isn’t this a crisis for us, the Filolial-sama faction?
“If I do my best in return, I want a reward.”
“What is it?”
“I want Gaelion to be Naofumi’s bride, too!”
“Gaelion! I’ve asked this before, but why do you like him so much?”
“Because Naofumi is kind. Gaelion really, really loves Naofumi.”
“Boo! I’m not giving Naofumi away!”
Just as Sakura-chan was about to pounce on her Rival, my Father stopped her.
“Well then! I guess we’ll be on our way.”
“I want you to listen to me!”
As if to change the subject, my Father made a declaration to the pig and placed his hand on the door handle. He quickly walked out.
“Motoyasu-sama, what should we do?”
“Just help Itsuki level up. Show him just how weak he is.”
“Is that so? Then Kou will do his best, too.”
“Understood. I’m not happy about it, but I’ll look after him as a special favor.”
“That shaggy-haired guy—he’s short, but not really cute.”
Luna muttered expressionlessly. Her assessment of Itsuki is absolutely devastating.
“Well, there’s also the matter of my Father, and so that the heroes can reassess their understanding of strength, I’d like Yuki and the others to teach Itsuki a thing or two.”
“Understood.”
“Well, once the team swap is over, we’ll move on to training the Filolial-sama, which I’ve been looking forward to. To prepare for that, I’d like you to research the island’s terrain.”
“Yay! Exploration, exploration!”
“More cute ones… Luna, I can’t wait.”
“It’s a boost to our combat strength. Well then, I’ll do my best for that, too.”
“I’ll leave it to you.”
After all, Yuki-chan is the representative among the Filolial-sama I’m registering. She’s a huge help with all sorts of odd jobs. I’m sure everything will be fine if I leave it to her this time, too.
“Well then, I’m off to join Itsuki’s group.”
“Have a good trip!”
“Good luck in battle!”
“I’ll do my best.”
And so, following the pig’s guidance, I headed toward the room where Itsuki’s companions were waiting.
